## Summary

What does this change and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature

## Testing

How was this verified? Include the operating systems and platforms used.

- [ ] `make ci` passes

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, keys, tokens or personal data are included.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behaviour changed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated for user-visible changes.
- [ ] Security implications have been considered (see `docs/threat-model.md`).
